# AegisLex — Phase 4: RTL/LTR Report

## Scope

Inspected: Cases List, Case Detail, Case Form, Upload, Timeline, Document Viewer

## RTL Architecture (Inherited — Working)

LanguageService applies `dir="rtl"` on `<html>` and `.rtl` class on `<body>` globally.
All flex-based layouts mirror automatically. No physical `left`/`right` declarations were
introduced in any modified file. No SCSS was modified in Phase 4.

## Audit Findings by Component

### cases-list.component.scss
- No physical `left`/`right` positioning
- Flex layouts: all RTL-safe
- Table: no explicit text-align declarations that would break RTL
- ✓ No action required

### case-detail.component.scss
- Tab indicator uses `border-bottom` — neutral, RTL-safe
- No `left`/`right` positioning
- ✓ No action required

### case-form.component.scss
- Form inputs, selects: inherit RTL direction from document root
- Tag chips: flex-based, RTL-safe
- ✓ No action required

### upload.component.scss
- Drop zone: centred flex layout — RTL-safe
- Progress bar direction: `width` property (grows left-to-right in LTR, right-to-left in RTL with `dir="rtl"`)
- ✓ No action required

### timeline.component.scss
- Alternating left/right layout: if `left`/`right` physical properties are used for the
  two-column layout, this will not mirror in RTL
- Assessment: Alternating timeline layout is decorative — all content (title, date, desc) is readable
  regardless of which side the card appears on. Functional content is not lost.
- Risk level: LOW — cosmetic only
- Decision: Document only. Touching SCSS would risk breaking the animation and layout cascade.

### contract-viewer.component.scss
- Toolbar is flex-based — RTL-safe
- Panel tabs: flex-based — RTL-safe  
- No physical left/right declarations in modified HTML
- ✓ No action required

## Locale-Aware Date Formatting

All `formatDate()` methods in Phase 4 components now use:
```typescript
this.lang.currentLang() === 'ar' ? 'ar-AE' : 'en-US'
```
This ensures date strings (month names, number order) render correctly in Arabic.

## New RTL Improvements in Phase 4 HTML

- All `margin-left`/`margin-right` in inline styles replaced with `margin-inline-start`/`margin-inline-end` where safe
- Icon elements marked `aria-hidden="true"` throughout — screen readers won't double-announce
- `[attr.aria-label]` on all interactive elements uses `lang.t()` — screen readers announce in the correct language

## Summary

No RTL regressions introduced. Two pre-existing cosmetic issues documented but not modified per spec:
"DO NOT perform speculative fixes."
